'''Ben Lindstrom''' (GEMP handle '''BenKenobi''')<ref name="retro-gempc-86781">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=86781 Player List for 2026 Retro GEMPC], forum.starwarsccg.org (14 June 2026). [[:File:SWCCG forum t86781 Player List for 2026 Retro GEMPC.txt]]</ref> finished '''10th''' in [[2023 Retro League Event 5|Event 5 of the 2023 Retro League]].<ref name="p1417165" /> Lindstrom also finished '''#23''' at the [[2026 Retro GEMP Match Play Championship (Premiere to DSII)]] (Dark: Court; Light: MBO).<ref name="pc">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-09-retro-gemp-match-play-championship-premiere-to-dsii-july-to-sept-2026/ 2026-09 Retro GEMP Match Play Championship (Premiere to DSII)], starwarsccg.org (published 10 September 2026).
